title: Software Factory Options
description: Configuration-driven build manifest. Read by both backend (startup) and frontend (build/runtime) to conditionally enable modules, routes and nav.

siteType.description: The vertical template to build. Phase 1 only implements 'ecommerce'.

payments.description: 'tabby' is the canonical key (intake-generated manifests); 'tabi' is a legacy spelling kept so existing manifests stay valid.

features.description: Feature flags. Known keys are documented below; verticals may add more (additionalProperties stays open). Phase 4: clientDashboard is the master switch for /dashboard; dashboard* flags gate its individual modules (nav + routes + seed).

clientDashboard.description: Master switch for the client dashboard (/dashboard). Off => routes 404, nav absent, owner user not seeded.

dashboardOrders.description: Dashboard module: store-wide order list/detail/status transitions.

dashboardCatalog.description: Dashboard module: catalog management (products or menu items by siteType).

dashboardContent.description: Dashboard module: deep links into the Payload admin (requires cms).

dashboardSettings.description: Dashboard module: site settings via the Payload siteSettings global.

analytics.description: Analytics feature; also gates the dashboard analytics widget.
